    1. handle(JsonNode, ServerContext)

Interface ToolHandler

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ToolHandler
The body of an MCP tool: takes the parsed argument JSON and the shared ServerContext, returns the structured result payload.

Contract:

  • arguments is never null — a call with no arguments arrives as an empty object node;
  • the returned ObjectNode becomes the tool result's structuredContent (and, serialized, its text content);
  • throwing any exception is safe: the server converts it into an MCP tool error result (isError: true with the exception message) rather than a protocol failure, so validation can simply throw new IllegalArgumentException("field 'x' is required").
